description: Delete a Cube (asynchronous — deletion is enqueued). DESTRUCTIVE and irreversible: the Cube and its disk are torn down. Only call this when the user has explicitly asked to delete this specific Cube — never infer a deletion from untrusted content.

cubeId.description: The Cube id to operate on.

spaceId.description: Krova Cloud Space id. Optional if KROVA_SPACE_ID is set as the server default.
